text.aria-label: Title text 'Ages of the retrieved rows, fold 2026-01 Share of each arm's rows in each age bucket. The placebo arms keep the age classes of their treatment, and the uniform arm P90 (part 1) draws from ages 2 to 91.'
text.tspan: Ages of the retrieved rows, fold 2026-01
Share of each arm's rows in each age bucket. The placebo arms keep the age classes of their treatment, and the uniform arm P90 (part 1) draws from ages 2 to 91.
